worst_moment: "You're using the wrong normal force. On an incline, N is mg cos 30, not mg. Try that and see what you get." - said after the student had already used 42.4 N, telling them they are wrong when they are right.
best_moment: "The cosine comes from the component of weight perpendicular to the incline." - starts to give the physical reason for cos, though it is never developed.
